lines.say: Ladies. Gentlemen. Ducks. Imagine... this. But more.
What is that?
That's the Preston Pavilion. It has a fountain inside a smaller fountain.
Where do the ducks go?
Level two.
Well! Yes. No. Let's form a committee. Yes.
That's my lake. That's my park. He said level two.
There's a town meeting in two weeks.
We don't have two weeks. We make the park so terrible he gives up. Operation Unbuyable.
I'm listening. I'm eating, but I'm listening.
One, a swamp smell. Two, rowdy locals. Three, a threatening sign.
My family can be rowdy.
You don't have to ask them to be.
What's the swamp smell made of?
That's your department.
Why is that my department?
You've got the most sensitive nose.
That's a rabbit thing. That's not a qualification.
What does the sign say?
Something that really frightens a rich guy.
Leave it with me.
I love this one. Who even makes this?
Some guy.
BASH! SWEETIE! HAVE YOU EATEN? WHO ELSE HASN'T EATEN?
Rowdy locals, deployed.
What... is that smell?
Terrible, right? Really puts you off. Bad for business.
Authentic.
What?
The noise. The stench. That sign! You can't buy rustic like this. Marlo, double the offer.
Doubled.
And who is responsible for this magnificent sign?
Some guy.
Buy it. Buy the sign. Put it in the lobby.
No. No no no. It's a warning!
It's a brand!
Should I get my family to be louder?
I don't think that helps.
BASH! YOUR UNCLE MADE THE GOOD POTATO SALAD!
Listen to that. Marlo, get her number.
Did we just make it worth more?
A little.
Double? Well. Goodness. Yes. No. Let me sit down.
Morning! Chilly for November, huh?
Sure is!
So chilly!
Is it? I mean, yes.
...Is it?
Hm.
You know I've never wanted to be anywhere else? That park, this street.
People always want to leave, and I just never did.
Then we keep it.
Yeah?
Yeah.
